QuestInfo.name: From Dreams
QuestInfo.0: You dreamt of the Black Mage and the one pursuing Mercedes. It was just a dream, yet it was so vivid... so real.
QuestInfo.1: Think about everything the Black Mage said.
QuestInfo.2: The Black Mage in your dream said that you're still alive because he, a Transcendent, still remembers you. He claims that you'll disappear when he does. Is the only reason you still live... the Black Mage?

0.0: Was... was that really just a dream? The Black Mage felt so real, and you saw the one who was pursuing Mercedes. Maybe that pursuer manipulated your dream?
0.1: The Black Mage feels like such a terrible presence. He feels like a nightmare I cannot awaken from.
0.2: I need to be calm... The Black Mage definitely remembered me. What did he say? I need to remember.

no.0: ...I should take a break. Trying to remember is too hard right now.

1.0: The Black Mage seemed to know my current plans. He said the only reason I'm still around is that... #ras a Transcendent, he still remembers me#k. So... I'm only alive because of him?
1.1: The only one who remembers me is the Black Mage, so if he goes away, I go with him. What a terrible thing to have my life depend on. Heh, if only it worked in reverse...
